_note: English questions were written by the team (2026-09-21). The zh versions were drafted by Claude and have not yet been checked by a native speaker; Tommy to review.

questions.en: Could you tell me a little bit about yourself? What are you most proud of, and what kind of work are you hoping to do here?
questions.zh: 可以简单介绍一下你自己吗？你最引以为傲的是什么？你希望在这里找什么样的工作？

questions.en: What is the best phone number and email address for employers to reach you?
questions.zh: 雇主联系你最好用哪个电话号码和电子邮箱？

questions.en: Let's talk about your education. What did you study, and what was the name of your school or university? Where was it located, and which years did you attend? Is there anything specific you'd like to highlight about what you learned there?
questions.zh: 我们来谈谈你的教育背景。你学的是什么专业？学校或大学叫什么名字？在哪里？哪几年就读？在那里学到的东西，有没有什么特别想强调的？

questions.en: I'd love to hear about your past work. What was your most recent job title, and what was the name of the company? Where was this job located? How long did you work there, and what were your main daily tasks?
questions.zh: 我想听听你过去的工作经历。你最近一份工作的职位是什么？公司叫什么名字？在哪里？你在那里工作了多久？每天主要做哪些工作？

questions.en: Have you ever done any unpaid work or volunteered to help your community? If so, what was your role, and where and when did you do this? Could you describe what you actually did to help out?
questions.zh: 你有没有做过无偿工作，或者当志愿者帮助你的社区？如果有，你的角色是什么？在哪里、什么时候？可以说说你具体做了哪些事情吗？

questions.en: What practical skills do you have? For example, are you good with any computer programs, specific tools, driving certain vehicles, or speaking multiple languages?
questions.zh: 你有哪些实用技能？比如会用哪些电脑软件、特定工具，会驾驶哪些车辆，或者会说几种语言？

questions.en: Do you have any official certificates, licenses, or special training records? This could be a driver's license, a safety card, or any professional training you completed.
questions.zh: 你有没有正式的证书、执照或者专业培训记录？比如驾照、安全证（safety card），或者你完成过的任何职业培训。
